cards.name: Oddish
cards.description: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.description: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

cards.name: Bellossom
cards.description: Bellossom gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.description: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

cards.name: Shuckle
cards.description: The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.

cards.name: Surskit
cards.description: They usually live on ponds, but after an evening shower, they may appear on puddles in towns.

cards.name: Masquerain
cards.description: It flaps its four wings to hover and fly freely in any direction—to and fro and sideways.

cards.name: Combee
cards.description: At night, Combee sleep in a group of about a hundred, packed closely together in a lump.

cards.name: Foongus
cards.description: There is a theory that the developer of the modern-day Poké Ball really liked Foongus, but this has not been confirmed.

cards.name: Amoonguss
cards.description: Be wary of the poisonous spores it releases. Mushrooms resembling Amoonguss's caps will grow out of anywhere the spores touch.

cards.name: Phantump
cards.description: With a voice like a human child's, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.

cards.name: Trevenant
cards.description: Small roots that extend from the tips of this Pokémon's feet can tie into the trees of the forest and give Trevenant control over them.

cards.name: Rowlet
cards.description: It feels relaxed in tight, dark places and has been known to use its Trainer's pocket or bag as a nest.

cards.name: Dartrix
cards.description: Supremely sensitive to the presence of others, it can detect opponents standing behind it, flinging its sharp feathers to take them out.

cards.name: Bounsweet
cards.description: Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled-down fruit. Because of this, Bounsweet was highly valued in the past, when sweeteners were scarce.

cards.name: Steenee
cards.description: Steenee spreads a sweet scent that makes others feel invigorated. This same scent is popular for antiperspirants.

cards.name: Tsareena
cards.description: This Pokémon is proud and aggressive. However, it is said that a Tsareena will instantly become calm if someone touches the crown on its calyx.

cards.name: Smoliv
cards.description: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

cards.name: Dolliv
cards.description: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

cards.name: Arboliva
cards.description: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

cards.name: Capsakid
cards.description: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

cards.name: Capsakid
cards.description: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

cards.name: Scovillain
cards.description: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.description: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.description: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.description: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.description: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

cards.name: Entei
cards.description: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

cards.name: Numel
cards.description: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. When it grows cold, the magma hardens and slows it.

cards.name: Camerupt
cards.description: It lives in the crater of a volcano. It is well known that the humps on its back erupt every 10 years.

cards.name: Darumaka
cards.description: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it's pushed or pulled.

cards.name: Darmanitan
cards.description: This Pokémon's power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.description: The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs, the brighter and eerier the flame on its head burns.

cards.name: Lampent
cards.description: It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp. Once it finds someone whose death is near, it will trail quietly after them.

cards.name: Chandelure
cards.description: In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of lights, funerals were a constant occurrence—or so it's said.

cards.name: Heatmor
cards.description: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

cards.name: Larvesta
cards.description: This Pokémon was called the Larva That Stole the Sun. The fire Larvesta spouts from its horns can cut right through a sheet of iron.

cards.name: Volcarona
cards.description: Its burning body causes it to be unpopular in hot parts of the world, but in cold ones, Volcarona is revered as an embodiment of the sun.

cards.name: Charcadet
cards.description: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

cards.name: Armarouge
cards.description: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.description: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.description: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

cards.name: Sharpedo
cards.description: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sea. Any ship entering the waters Sharpedo calls home will be attacked—no exceptions.

cards.name: Buizel
cards.description: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

cards.name: Floatzel
cards.description: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

cards.name: Tympole
cards.description: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can't hear its cries of warning.

cards.name: Palpitoad
cards.description: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.

cards.name: Seismitoad
cards.description: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.

cards.name: Cubchoo
cards.description: Many of this species can be found along the shorelines of cold regions. If a Cubchoo lacks dangling snot, there's a chance it is sick.

cards.name: Beartic
cards.description: It is a ferocious, carnivorous Pokémon. Once it captures its prey, it will breathe cold air onto the prey to freeze and preserve it.

cards.name: Cryogonal
cards.description: Cryogonal appear during cold seasons. It is said that people and Pokémon who die on snowy mountains are reborn into these Pokémon.

cards.name: Froakie
cards.description: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

cards.name: Frogadier
cards.description: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 600 metres in a minute's time.

cards.name: Wiglett
cards.description: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

cards.name: Wugtrio
cards.description: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

cards.name: Finizen
cards.description: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

cards.name: Finizen
cards.description: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

cards.name: Palafin
cards.description: This Pokémon's ancient genes have awakened. It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.description: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.description: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

cards.name: Magnezone
cards.description: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.description: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

cards.name: Eelektrik
cards.description: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

cards.name: Eelektross
cards.description: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

cards.name: Thundurus
cards.description: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.

cards.name: Toxel
cards.description: It has no problem drinking dirty water. An organ inside Toxel's body filters such water into a poisonous liquid that is harmless to Toxel.

cards.name: Toxtricity
cards.description: Many youths admire the way this Pokémon listlessly picks fights and keeps its cool no matter what opponent it faces.

cards.name: Tadbulb
cards.description: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

cards.name: Tadbulb
cards.description: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

cards.name: Tadbulb
cards.description: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

cards.name: Bellibolt
cards.description: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

cards.name: Bellibolt
cards.description: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

cards.name: Cleffa
cards.description: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.description: Its adorable behavior and cry make it highly popular. However, this cute Pokémon is rarely found.

cards.name: Togepi
cards.description: It is considered to be a symbol of good luck. Its shell is said to be filled with happiness.

cards.name: Togetic
cards.description: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

cards.name: Togekiss
cards.description: Known as a bringer of blessings, it's been depicted on good-luck charms since ancient times.

cards.name: Espeon
cards.description: The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is predicting its opponent's next move.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.description: In contrast to its appearance, it's quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

cards.name: Granbull
cards.description: Although it's popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it's totally incompetent as a watchdog.

cards.name: Mawile
cards.description: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

cards.name: Spoink
cards.description: Spoink will die if it stops bouncing. The pearl on its head amplifies its psychic powers.

cards.name: Grumpig
cards.description: It can perform odd dance steps to influence foes. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

cards.name: Lunatone
cards.description: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

cards.name: Solrock
cards.description: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

cards.name: Baltoy
cards.description: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

cards.name: Claydol
cards.description: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

cards.name: Sinistea
cards.description: The soul of someone who died alone possessed some leftover tea. This Pokémon appears in hotels and houses.

cards.name: Polteageist
cards.description: The tea that composes Polteageist's body has a distinct and enjoyable flavor. Drinking too much, however, can be fatal.

cards.name: Greavard
cards.description: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.

cards.name: Greavard
cards.description: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.

cards.name: Houndstone
cards.description: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.

cards.name: Diglett
cards.description: It lives about one yard underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

cards.name: Dugtrio
cards.description: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.description: Born deep underground, this Pokémon becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.

cards.name: Pupitar
cards.description: This pupa flies around wildly by venting with great force the gas pressurized inside its body.

cards.name: Nosepass
cards.description: It hunts without twitching a muscle by pulling in its prey with powerful magnetism. But sometimes it pulls natural enemies in close.

cards.name: Barboach
cards.description: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey's location.

cards.name: Whiscash
cards.description: It is extremely protective of its territory. If any foe approaches, it attacks using vicious tremors.

cards.name: Bonsly
cards.description: In order to adjust the level of fluids in its body, it exudes water from its eyes. This makes it appear to be crying.

cards.name: Drilbur
cards.description: It's a digger, using its claws to burrow through the ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so many farmers have little love for it.

cards.name: Stunfisk
cards.description: For some reason, this Pokémon smiles slightly when it emits a strong electric current from the yellow markings on its body.

cards.name: Diggersby
cards.description: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.

cards.name: Crabrawler
cards.description: This Pokémon punches trees and eats the berries that drop down, training itself and getting food at the same time.

cards.name: Crabominable
cards.description: The detached pincers of these Pokémon are delicious. Some Trainers bring Lechonk into the mountains just to search for them.

cards.name: Rockruff
cards.description: This Pokémon is very friendly when it's young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

cards.name: Lycanroc
cards.description: This Pokémon uses its rocky mane to slash any who approach. It will even disobey its Trainer if it dislikes the orders it was given.

cards.name: Toedscool
cards.description: Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that fall from its body are chewy and very delicious.

cards.name: Toedscruel
cards.description: These Pokémon gather into groups and form colonies deep within forests. They absolutely hate it when strangers approach.

cards.name: Glimmet
cards.description: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.

cards.name: Glimmet
cards.description: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.

cards.name: Paldean Wooper
cards.description: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

cards.name: Paldean Wooper
cards.description: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

cards.name: Paldean Clodsire
cards.description: When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body. It's a risky move that puts everything on the line.

cards.name: Paldean Clodsire
cards.description: When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body. It's a risky move that puts everything on the line.

cards.name: Umbreon
cards.description: When exposed to the moon's aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.

cards.name: Houndour
cards.description: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.

cards.name: Houndour
cards.description: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.

cards.name: Houndoom
cards.description: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.

cards.name: Darkrai
cards.description: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

cards.name: Inkay
cards.description: By exposing foes to the blinking of its luminescent spots, Inkay demoralizes them, and then it seizes the chance to flee.

cards.name: Malamar
cards.description: It's said that Malamar's hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.description: It taunts its prey and lures them into narrow, rocky areas where it then sprays them with toxic gas to make them dizzy and take them down.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.description: Salazzle makes its opponents light-headed with poisonous gas, then captivates them with alluring movements to turn them into loyal servants.

cards.name: Scizor
cards.description: This Pokémon's pincers, which contain steel, can crush any hard object they get ahold of into bits.

cards.name: Skarmory
cards.description: People fashion swords from Skarmory's shed feathers, so this Pokémon is a popular element in heraldic designs.

cards.name: Mawile
cards.description: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.description: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor's back contained a mysterious power.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.description: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.

cards.name: Probopass
cards.description: It uses three small units to catch prey and battle enemies. The main body mostly just gives orders.

cards.name: Excadrill
cards.description: Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.description: Pawniard will fearlessly challenge even powerful foes. In a pinch, it will cling to opponents and pierce them with the blades all over its body.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.description: This Pokémon commands a group of several Pawniard. Groups that are defeated in territorial disputes are absorbed by the winning side.

cards.name: Kingambit
cards.description: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

cards.name: Togedemaru
cards.description: When it's in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

cards.name: Meltan
cards.description: They live as a group, but when the time comes, one strong Meltan will absorb all the others and evolve.

cards.name: Varoom
cards.description: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

cards.name: Varoom
cards.description: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.description: It sheds many layers of skin as it grows larger. During this process, it is protected by a rapid waterfall.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.description: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.description: If it bonds with a person, it will gently envelop the friend with its soft wings, then hum.

cards.name: Drampa
cards.description: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

cards.name: Pidgey
cards.description: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

cards.name: Pidgeotto
cards.description: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

cards.name: Kangaskhan
cards.description: There are records of a lost human child being raised by a childless Kangaskhan.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

cards.name: Zigzagoon
cards.description: A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigzags.

cards.name: Linoone
cards.description: It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey. Running along winding paths is not its strong suit.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.description: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

cards.name: Lillipup
cards.description: This Pokémon is far brighter than the average child, and Lillipup won't forget the love it receives or any abuse it suffers.

cards.name: Herdier
cards.description: The black fur that covers this Pokémon's body is dense and springy. Even sharp fangs bounce right off.

cards.name: Stoutland
cards.description: Stoutland is immensely proud of its impressive moustache. It's said that moustache length is what determines social standing among this species.

cards.name: Audino
cards.description: This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures' feelings and physical conditions.

cards.name: Bouffalant
cards.description: These Pokémon live in herds of about 20 individuals. Bouffalant that betray the herd will lose the hair on their heads for some reason.

cards.name: Bunnelby
cards.description: It's very sensitive to danger. The sound of Corviknight's flapping will have Bunnelby digging a hole to hide underground in moments.

cards.name: Yungoos
cards.description: Its stomach fills most of its torso. It wanders the same path every day, searching for fresh food.

cards.name: Gumshoos
cards.description: Once it finds signs of prey, it will patiently stake out the location, waiting until the sun goes down.

cards.name: Skwovet
cards.description: It stores berries in its cheeks. When there are no berries to be found, Skwovet will stuff pebbles into its cheeks to stave off its cravings.

cards.name: Lechonk
cards.description: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn't use it for anything other than foraging.

cards.name: Oinkologne
cards.description: Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.

cards.name: Oinkologne
cards.description: This Pokémon sends a flowerlike scent wafting about. Well-developed muscles in its legs allow it to leap more than 16 feet with no trouble at all.

cards.name: Flamigo
cards.description: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that the energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.description: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.description: Born deep underground, this Pokémon becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.

cards.name: Houndour
cards.description: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.

cards.name: Scizor

cards.name: Varoom
cards.description: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.
